title: Research index
summary: A lab notebook made public. Numbered, ruled, precise, confident. Color works as an index or a highlighter, never as decoration.
use_when: Research-heavy, technical or trust-critical products: infrastructure, data, protocols, anything where 'we are rigorous' is the pitch.
avoid_when: Consumer warmth, or emotional products. It reads cold without a highlight color or a character (Hone uses mascot faces to warm it).
